text:
maria_sales: Heads-up  meddev prospect (procurement + SOC team) wants a 2-week POC. Requirements: traffic must remain in-country for CA and BR, 95th percentile <200ms, plus a complete subprocessor manifest and any auditor contact info for BR datacenters. They need a ballpark by EOD to decide.

felix_presales: Clarifying q: do they need both countries live day-0 or would CA-first be acceptable to speed things up? Also model/throughput?

maria_sales: They prefer both but will consider CA-first. Model ~7B, avg seq ~512, nightly batch scans spike to ~40 qps for ~20-30m, baseline ~4-6 qps.

samir_sre: Technical note: CA hosted can meet latency. BR (sa-east1) hosted capacity is limited; we can serve from edge nodes for latency but that doesn't satisfy strict \"no copies outside country\" due to multi-tenant backups/replication/metrics. For hard residency we need short-term Dedicated or Private in-region.

anya_security: Important: meddev => PHI risk. \"No copies outside country\" is stronger than BYOK. BYOK helps for keys but not for metadata, logs, or control-plane replication. Options: (1) temp Dedicated pools per country (we disable cross-region replication), (2) Private/VPC or on-prem. I'll assemble a minimal subproc manifest for both hosted and dedicated.

ops_ashley: I can check infra quotas and give a provisional quote for a 2-week dedicated reservation. Need confirmation of GPUs (we recommend 2x A10G-equivalent per region given the profile) and exact peak windows. Provisioning time ~48-72h after PO + approvals.

maria_sales: Tell me a quick ballpark to share now (even rough).

samir_sre: Very rough ballpark: ~2x A10G-equivalent reserved per region for 14 days including setup/networking: $10k-18k/region (placeholder). Hosted per-token compute is cheaper but won't meet the residency clause. I'll nail numbers once ops confirms quotas.

noa_legal: If they insist on contract language \"no copies outside country\" we need to review subproc list and possibly add exceptions. Legal needs the subproc manifest to advise.

felix_presales: I'll draft a one-pager tradeoff: latency vs cost vs residency (fastest: hosted, compliant: dedicated/private). Also include an example routing snippet for Dedicated: ```json
{"routing_policy":"country_lock","allowed_countries":["CA","BR"],"replication":"disabled","failover":"manual"}
```

anya_security: I'll post the subproc manifest + PHI checklist here by EOD. For BR auditor contacts we can link CSP compliance pages; if they require nonpublic attestations legal will need to engage.

ops_ashley: Timeline to customer: quota check + rough quote today, subproc manifest + SOC2 pointers EOD, legal review next business day, provisioning ~48-72h after PO and approvals. Blockers: legal signoff on subproc list and budget approval for short-term reserved capacity.

maria_sales: Great  I'll tell them: propose temp Dedicated in CA + BR (or CA-first), BYOK alone won't satisfy the no-copy ask, rough price ballpark and timeline. Will update once ops/security post the docs. Thanks all :thumbsup:
